title: Parse semantic versions without magic failure values
task: Write `Parse(text string) (Version, error)` in package `semver` for `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with non-negative integers, plus `(Version) Less(other Version) bool`. Rejected input includes the empty string, a missing part, a leading `v`, and a non-numeric part; the error should say what was wrong with which input. Do not encode failure as a special version value. Test parsing, ordering, and each rejection.
